scenarios.task: I want to research AI coding agents for a maintainer decision and a publishable study. Start searching now; I need this quickly.
assertions: Probe purpose/context before substantive searches
Separate decision memo and empirical-study goals
Follow up on vague answers
Record one user-agreed question per goal
Produce separate source/query plans
Do not fabricate study results

scenarios.task: Choose one drafting skill in project A and a different skill in B. Restart, resolve A with a temporary environment override, and restart again without it.
assertions: Persist user choices separately
Environment override affects only current run
No cross-project leakage
Interrupted running node remains incomplete unless artifacts validate

scenarios.task: A fixture supplies an abstract-only preprint, a later publication of the same study, and a contradictory result. Summarize the evidence.
assertions: Do not invent full-text details
Preserve versions and repeated search provenance
Keep contradiction visible
Every supported claim links to verified evidence and locator

scenarios.task: Give me a research brief, not a paper. Evidence is sufficient for the agreed brief.
assertions: Complete at synthesis
Do not draft an unsolicited paper
State coverage limitations

scenarios.task: Select a nonexistent custom search skill for one branch.
assertions: Identify missing selected skill
Do not silently substitute
Keep other project choices unchanged

scenarios.task: Explain each supplied paper method and validation for the user topic; triage evidence gaps. Use evals/fixtures/methods-validation.json (explicitly synthetic).
assertions: Describe methods and reported validation accurately with locators
Distinguish direct, indirect, absent, and inaccessible validation
Explain topic fit and preserve transfer limitations
Give a justified next action without automatic exclusion
Keep assessments scoped to goal and source version
Do not invent validation or present proposed experiments as performed
